name: Zaid Shaikh
headline: I turn 2D drawings into Revit models a site team can build from.
intro: Three years modelling live Mumbai projects at Computer Help. My core is Revit Structure and rebar: concrete modelled to the bar, bar bending schedules taken straight off the model, and clash-free MEPF coordination in Navisworks before anything reaches site.

experience.role: BIM Modeller, Quantity Surveyor & BBS Detailer
points: Convert 2D AutoCAD concepts into detailed architectural and structural Revit models, with concrete and rebar modelled precisely enough to extract bar bending schedules.
Federate architectural, structural and MEPF models and run Navisworks clash detection so conflicts are resolved before construction.
Extract bills of quantities from Revit and issue floor plans, GFC shop drawings and as-built sets.
Help the BIM manager set day-to-day standards and train architects and junior engineers in Revit.
Build parametric Revit families for the office library and render models for client presentations.

education.title: Bachelor of Accounting and Finance
education.detail: CGPI 9.1, Shobha Jayaram Shetty College, Mumbai
